text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Omeprazole belongs to the class of proton pump inhibitors [clarithromycin:drug_interactions:11, omeprazole:contraindications:1], which can cause hypochlorhydria and affect intragastric pH [levothyroxine:drug_interactions:2]. Because gastric acidity is essential for the adequate absorption of levothyroxine, proton pump inhibitors may reduce its absorption [levothyroxine:drug_interactions:2]. It is recommended to administer levothyroxine at least 4 hours prior to these drugs or to monitor TSH levels appropriately [levothyroxine:drug_interactions:2].
